title: Distribution of doubling times across the ensemble
caption: Doubling-time histogram across seeds and generations.
interpretation: The distribution shows the true ~43 min gen-1 mode plus a longer gen-2 mode inflated by the step-window cap. The physiologically meaningful gen-1 mode sits in the expected band for the baseline glucose condition.
simulations: 2-seed x 2-gen wild-type baseline ensemble (showcase2-baseline-full), Ray-parallel, XArray/zarr + parquet emit.
